dispositionNotes.reason: The Headbutt reset trade take repeats the same command sequence; its trade continuation is noted on the adjacent hit-reset reference rather than counted again.
Forward-throw dash-only advantage illustration is not counted separately from the meaningful dash/Hellstab or delayed-SPD follow-ups.
Repeated light/Lariat, forward-throw and SPD knockdowns supply setup prerequisites. They are not relabeled as new continuous combos.

limits: Source printed +38/+27/+6 values describe advantage, not wait counts.
Only the displayed SA3 is authored where the overlay prints SA2 or SA3.
Normal and OD Lariat, forward-held spacing, light/medium/heavy SPD, and normal versus punish-counter forward throws remain distinct prerequisites.
SA1 jump catches are defensive reads after reset gaps, not guaranteed combos.
Manon SA1 and Ryu OD-DP blocks establish only the recorded matchup interaction.
No separate carry lesson or general-purpose grounded Lariat anti-air response is claimed.

sources.title: Street Fighter 6: Zangief Anti Air guide (Tips and Tricks)
sources.creator: Baldy

intervals.reason: Screened original examples include menus, setup actions and failed/unclear anti-air tests. The left-side input history is absent; the persistent OD-success indicator does not establish which attempt succeeded. No OD-Lariat anti-air recipe inferred from glow alone.
Screened corner and jump tests do not supply a sufficiently clear complete command/strength/success demonstration for an additional reviewed reference.

preservation: All 12 baseline reference objects including IDs, revisions, source data, media and related links remain unchanged. New related links are authored only on appended entries.
